A '''golden hoe''' is a [[Tools#Hoe|hoe]] of the [[Golden equipment|golden]] tier, crafted from two [[gold ingot]]s and two sticks. With [[Fortune]] I it is useful for harvesting crops and leaves.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Farming ===
It breaks hoe blocks at the vanilla speed of 12 and has 350 durability. Hoes in Matcha Flavoured also break wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref> Golden gear comes with its enchantments already applied. They are ordinary enchantments, so they can be combined or removed like any other.

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|1}} damage at an attack speed of 1.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[gold ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one gold ingot.
